name: compose
shape: Django with docker-compose and a long-running sender

platform.name: Unknown
platform.why: docker/docker-compose.yml is a self-hosting sample and the publish workflow only pushes an image to a registry; nothing names a host

processes.note: Dockerfile CMD and the compose service web start uwsgi with module hc.wsgi:application on :8000
attach-daemon ./manage.py sendalerts runs beside uWSGI in the web container, polling the database for status flips and checks going down and sending notifications on a thread pool
attach-daemon ./manage.py sendreports --loop polls every second for due monthly/weekly reports and nags
attach-daemon ./manage.py smtpd only when SMTPD_PORT is set; receives pings by email on a raw TCP port

data.note: service db with the volume db-data; hc/settings.py also supports MySQL/MariaDB and falls back to SQLite (hc.sqlite) when DB is unset, but docker/.env.example sets postgres
S3_BUCKET and friends; ping bodies go there via hc/lib/s3.py when set, else into the database

breaks.note: a forever loop that polls the database (a DB-backed queue of flips) and sleeps 2 s when idle; needs an always-on worker, not a request-driven container
--loop wakes every second and sends reports whose next_report_date is due; a scheduler living in a process

remove_objects starts a Thread that is not joined; it is called from Check.prune on every 100th ping inside the web request (hc/api/models.py), so the S3 deletes outlive the response and are throttled on Cloud Run

notBreaks.why: opens search.db, a read-only docs search index committed to the repository and baked into the image; no user data is written to it
a developer command that rebuilds the committed search.db; not run by any process
a developer command that writes highlighted snippets into templates/; not run by any process
a developer command that renders docs into templates/ before a commit; not run by any process
browser code served as a static asset, a setInterval in the page

notes: Read docker/Dockerfile, docker/docker-compose.yml, docker/uwsgi.ini, hc/settings.py, hc/lib/s3.py, hc/api/models.py and every management command. The compose file declares only web and db, but uwsgi.ini attaches three daemons to the web container (sendalerts, sendreports --loop and, with SMTPD_PORT, smtpd); after a move they become separate always-on workers, and the SMTP listener has no Cloud Run equivalent (Cloud Run accepts only HTTP/gRPC), which no rule covers yet. uwsgi.ini also runs manage.py migrate as hook-pre-app on every start; that is a migration at startup rather than a release step, so it is in no list. The other management commands (prune*, send*notices, sendlogs) are meant for cron but nothing in the repository schedules them.

known.FALSE break: sqlite-database hc/front/vi: opens a read-only docs search index committed to the repository (search.db); sqlite3.connect is the same call as for a database that is written, and the rule cannot read the mode
known.MISSED break: queue-worker hc/api/manage: a polling loop in a management command that a process manager starts; the loop is no pattern a rule knows, and the process that runs it is not read either (see the process lines)
known.MISSED break: in-process-timer hc/api/ma: a polling loop in a management command that a process manager starts; the loop is no pattern a rule knows, and the process that runs it is not read either (see the process lines)
known.process missing: 3 x worker: three daemons in docker/uwsgi.ini (`attach-daemon = ./manage.py sendalerts`, sendreports, smtpd), started by a process manager or script that no reader opens
known.data missing: files: S3-compatible storage is optional and set by S3_BUCKET in settings; no manifest or dependency names it
